purpose: SlicerBabelBrain integrates 3D Slicer with the external BabelBrain application to run transcranial focused ultrasound (tFUS) acoustic and thermal simulations for trajectories planned in Slicer. It is intended for researchers planning and evaluating tFUS neuromodulation trajectories using subject T1w MRI volumes and SimNIBS segmentations.
summary:
This extension provides a clean, well-structured bridge between 3D Slicer and the external open-source BabelBrain application for transcranial focused ultrasound simulations. All Python and CMake files at commit a3c72bfc7874d413739c4f4dea66b45d1e2ea73e were inspected. It has no external Python package installations, no network activity, safe local file handling via atomic JSON writes in `~/.BabelBrainSync`, non-blocking subprocess execution, thorough self-tests, and a permissive BSD 3-Clause license. All three admission requirements (security/safety, clear distribution permission, and a mechanically usable catalog entry) are met.

🟢 Recommend merge

safety.rationale: Inspected all Python and CMake files in the repository (commit a3c72bfc7874d413739c4f4dea66b45d1e2ea73e); the extension performs no network communication, uses safe JSON and NIfTI header parsing, and only launches the local BabelBrain executable when explicitly triggered by the user.

environment.rationale: Inspected BabelBrain/BabelBrain.py and BabelBrain/BabelBrainLib/SyncProtocol.py; the extension only imports standard Python libraries, numpy, qt, ctk, vtk, and slicer, without installing packages or altering Slicer's shared Python environment.

packaging.rationale: Inspected CMakeLists.txt, BabelBrain/CMakeLists.txt, and the catalog entry JSON; all Python scripts and icon resources exist and are properly registered in slicerMacroBuildScriptedModule, and dependencies match.

license.rationale: Inspected LICENSE and README.md; the repository is licensed under the BSD 3-Clause License, which permits redistribution, and no restricted third-party code or weights are bundled.

soundness.rationale: Inspected BabelBrain/BabelBrain.py and BabelBrain/BabelBrainLib/SyncProtocol.py; the module follows Slicer ScriptedLoadableModule conventions, runs the external process asynchronously with QTimer polling, cleans up observers and timers, and includes unit and end-to-end mock tests.

utility.rationale: Inspected README.md and BabelBrain/BabelBrain.py; the extension provides clear documentation, input validation hints, overlay visualization controls, automated tests, and a clear research-only clinical disclaimer.

not_checked: External BabelBrain application binary/source (https://github.com/ProteusMRIgHIFU/BabelBrain), which users install separately.
Binary image files: Screenshot.png (2 MB), BabelBrain.png, and BabelBrain/Resources/Icons/BabelBrain.png.
